description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's whitespace and diff behavior, particularly focusing on whitespace handling with various 'git diff' commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_must_pass
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to pass.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test tick counter to ensure chronological correctness.
